ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the subject action. When it matches a stored subject action, that subject action is updated. Otherwise a new subject action is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Source.description: Source that owns the subject action. A subject action cannot be imported without a source.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the subject action.

SubjectContentType.description: Subject content type this action belongs to.

DispositionId.description: Identifier of the disposition that triggers this action.

DispositionGuidance.description: What this disposition means for this subject, given to the AI when it dispositions an automated call or message. Replaces the disposition's own description.

SetDoNotCall.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not Call' preference when this action runs.

SetDoNotSms.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not SMS' preference when this action runs.

SetDoNotEmail.description: Whether to set the contact's 'Do Not Email' preference when this action runs.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the subject action, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

SubjectActions.description: Subject actions to create or update.
